resources.string: Readings are arriving and the watch has the latest one.
This app reads glucose from LinX or Dexcom ONE+ notifications. Enable notification access for the selected source; other apps are ignored.
Permission is granted. Open the selected CGM app so it refreshes its notification. For Dexcom ONE+, enable Quick Glance.
Nothing has arrived recently from the selected source. Check that its CGM app is running and connected to the sensor.
Readings are arriving, but the watch is out of range or switched off. It will catch up on its own once it reconnects.

Readings are arriving, but CGM Glance is not installed on your watch yet. Install it on your watch from Google Play (either from the "Available on more devices" menu on this phone, or under "Apps on your phone" in the watch\'s Play Store). If you installed from an APK, both phone and watch must come from the same build.
The selected source is being read through its fallback parser. Verify its notification format; Dexcom support still needs validation on a real device.
Shows a value the official app has already computed. Not a medical device: never use it for treatment decisions, and always confirm with the official app or a meter.
Source for watch and Health Connect
Glucose only · trend calculated by CGM Glance

LinX is selected by default and has priority while both sensors run. Sources never switch automatically. Select Dexcom ONE+ here when you are ready. Histories stay separate. If the new source has no reading yet, the watch keeps the previous value with its original age until a reading arrives.
Enable Quick Glance in Dexcom ONE+ and grant notification access to CGM Glance — Dexcom ONE+. Glucose must include an explicit unit; ambiguous notifications are refused.
Used for colour and wording only. This app never alerts on these values — alarms stay with the official app.
Urgent low must be below low, low below high, and high below very high. All four must be values a sensor can report.
Tells you when CGM Glance has stopped receiving readings.
CGM Glance cannot read glucose without it. Tap to fix.
Nothing has arrived for a while from the selected CGM source. Check that its app is running and connected to the sensor.
Off. Turn it on under “Settings” to write readings to Health Connect.
Writing one reading every %1$d minutes to Health Connect. Samsung Health reads them from there, if you have enabled that link in its settings.
Set up. The next reading due will be written, then one every %1$d minutes.
Allow CGM Glance to write glucose to Health Connect. Samsung Health then reads it from there.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. Install it, then turn on the Health Connect link inside Samsung Health.
Health Connect needs updating before it can accept readings.
The last write failed. Readings are still reaching the watch.
Writes your readings to Health Connect, which Samsung Health reads from. Nothing is ever read back.
Between %1$d and %2$d minutes. The default is 15.
The interval must be between %1$d and %2$d minutes.
How to install the app on your watch and display glucose on your watch face, tile, or phone screen.
Install the companion app on your Wear OS watch so readings can reach your wrist.
Option A — From your phone\'s Google Play
Tap "Open in Google Play" below, expand "Available on more devices" (next to Installed/Open), tick your watch, and tap Install.
Option B — Directly from your watch
Open the Google Play Store on your watch, scroll down to "Apps on your phone", select CGM Glance, and tap Install.
Once installed, the Watch row in Details above changes to "Connected" and the latest reading is sent automatically.
Tip: Keep Bluetooth and Wi-Fi enabled on your watch during installation so Google Play downloads the watch app quickly.
Always visible on your main watch face alongside the time.
Press and hold your watch screen, then tap Customize (or edit it from the Galaxy Wearable / Pixel Watch app on your phone).
Swipe left across the customization pages until the data slots on the watch face are highlighted.
Tap the slot where you want glucose to appear, scroll the list, and pick CGM Glance (Glucose).
Tip: Tapping the complication on your watch opens the full CGM Glance screen with the reading\'s exact age. If a built-in watch face only accepts icons, choose a face with a text slot.
A dedicated full-screen card with large numbers, one swipe away from your watch face.
From the watch face, swipe left through your existing tiles (or open the Tiles section in the Galaxy Wearable / Pixel Watch phone app).
Long-press any tile or swipe all the way to the end and tap the + (Add tile) button.
Scroll to CGM Glance and tap it to add the tile. Drag it to the first position so it sits right next to your watch face.
Tip: The tile colours the reading by range (green, amber, red) and dims it automatically if data becomes stale.
Live glucose, calculated trend arrow, and reading age on your phone home screen.
Touch and hold an empty space on your phone\'s home screen and tap Widgets.
Drag CGM Glance to the screen
Find CGM Glance in the widget list, then touch and hold the Glucose widget to place it where you want.
Pick whether the widget follows your watch source or stays pinned to LinX or Dexcom ONE+, then tap Save.
Tip: Tapping the widget opens the official sensor app. You can place two widgets side by side to compare two sensors at once.
